threading_root_cause_analysis.finding: Ollama recreates runner process (llama-server) whenever num_thread changes, incurring 120-212s model cold load in Docker under WSL2 memory pressure.
threading_root_cause_analysis.spinlock_contention: On a 2-physical-core CPU, num_thread=4 spawns 4 OpenMP worker threads across 2 physical cores, triggering spinlock convoying and CPU starvation under memory pressure. num_thread=2 matches physical cores and eliminates contention.
threading_root_cause_analysis.apparent_4x_explanation: Previous run alternated num_thread per turn, so every turn paid runner cold-load. The apparent 4x speedup was an artifact of runner recreation delays and paging variance, not pure thread execution scaling.
